name: D3 Performance
old_description: A powerful OBD2 programmer that can load tunes, display important engine information, and read and clear DTCs.
about:
D3 Performance is based in League City, Texas. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The company develops and sells performance tuning hardware and software for Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Its product line includes OBD2 programmers that load custom calibrations, display engine data, and clear diagnostic codes; professional tuning software for building custom maps; and Harrop Engineering supercharger kits for the 3.5L V6 and 3.4L V6 platforms. D3 also provides custom tune files and E85 conversion add-ons for supported models.

D3 serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting owners and shops working on late-model Toyota and Lexus platforms. Supported applications include the 2022+ Tundra 3.4L V6, third-generation Tacoma, 2012-2017 Camry 2.5L and 3.5L, 2013-2017 Avalon and ES-350, 2018-2024 Lexus IS/RC/GS 3.5L, and the LC500, RC-F, and GS-F. The company also supports the 2AR-FE four-cylinder in the Camry and Scion tC.

D3 emphasizes several differentiators: real wide-open-throttle fuel control for increased boost and aggressive timing, sustained higher commanded boost across the rev range, and removal of throttle-closure torque limits and speed limiters. The company backs its hardware with a 30-day money-back guarantee and offers phone and email support during Central Time business hours.
